faq.q: What is the origin of Awwal?
faq.a: Awwal is associated with Arabic. Awwal ('first, foremost'); al-Awwal is one of the divine names in Qur'an 57:3.
Yes — the underlying form أوّل is Arabic.
Awwal can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Awwal should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. الأوّل is a name of God in the Qur'an (57:3)
